Description: JSON Interface for Audio Scene Management (CAE-ASM): what the person says becomes a User Command request (CAE-UCM, UserCommandRQ) and the User Command response (UserCommandRS) becomes the Response Hint. The application is the entries of its Access, the Application Context: the schema of the User Command (both the commands and the responses), and the Application Context of Audio Scene Management, which gives the frame and the units of the numbers (metres, x to the right of the user, y ahead, z up; degrees; LUFS), the parts of the command a person's words can use, and examples. The state of the scene (its objects and where they are) is what the responses that list the scene tell it. The editing AIMs all answer every command: Responders says how many, so that their answers are one response. Positions, orientations and loudness are absolute numbers; a request that needs a number it does not give is not turned into a command, and the Response Hint asks for the number.

AccessSources.Name: CommandSchema
AccessSources.Description: The schema of the User Command of Audio Scene Management: a command is an Instance of it that carries a UserCommandRQ.

AccessSources.Name: ResponseSchema
AccessSources.Description: The same schema: a response is an Instance of it that carries a UserCommandRS.

AccessSources.Name: ApplicationContext
AccessSources.Description: What the schema of the User Command does not say about Audio Scene Management: the frame and the units of its numbers, the parts of the command a person can use, the names the scene has, how the scene is told, the words of the responses, and examples.

AccessSources.Name: llm-weights
AccessSources.Description: The weights of the language model of the dialogue (Llama 3.2, 3 billion parameters, Q4_K_M), in the form Ollama publishes them. Ollama is given them from Access and creates the model.

AccessSources.Name: llm-template
AccessSources.Description: The chat template of the model.

AccessSources.Name: llm-parameters
AccessSources.Description: The default parameters of the model (its stop tokens).
